name: Nonattained Zero Source-Spectral Product
definition: Take the Cartesian product, on disjoint coordinate sets, of the seventeen-state nonlinear source-domain class $C_{17}$ and the five-coordinate path learning space $L_{\mathrm{path},5}$.
properties: This is a 272-concept union-closed class with $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}=\tau=0$. In the displayed product orientation the infimum $d_{\mathrm{sp}}=0$ is not attained by any finite positive coefficient array: giving the two factors rooted ratios $2^t$ and $2^{-t}$ yields ratio $4^{-t}$, while every finite array retains a finite positive threshold from the first factor and a positive negative threshold from the second.
